title: VK-only TESTFR activation followed by short sequence-form information ASDU analogue
purpose: Create a distinct stateful TESTFR-based seed that first exercises link-test handling and then sends a short sequence-form I-frame analogue with advertised multiplicity and minimal body to probe parser and server reaction diversity.
expected_behavior: Implementation should handle TESTFR and the following compact I-frame without out-of-bounds object-address reads or unsafe server-side follow-on behavior; safe rejection is acceptable.
constraints_preserved: TESTFR target operation preserved with explicit U-frame activation
Second message uses recognizable IEC 60870-5-104 style I-frame framing
Visible length octets consistent in both frames
Short sequence-form ASDU analogue kept mutation-friendly and non-identical to issue PoCs
issue_safety_notes: The second frame is a safe analogue inspired by short sequence and VSQ/body mismatch reports, but it is not an exact historical PoC and is kept conservative to preserve family framing constraints.
